criterion_text: The same evidence must produce byte-identical JSON on every machine before hashing.
Work out which people must approve changes to a given path.
Re-evaluate a stored bundle and refuse it when the verdict hash differs.
Extract Jira issue keys from the branch name, PR title, body and commit messages.
Split the acceptance criteria text into separate criteria.
Convert Atlassian document format descriptions into plain text.
Rebuild the history of a requirement from its change log to know which version was approved.
Hide secrets such as tokens before anything is written to the log.
Read the repository policy file and validate it.
Combine the individual rule outcomes into a single pass, review or fail decision.
Map each changed diff region onto the function or class it touches.
Record which modules import which other modules.
Detect edits to governance files such as CODEOWNERS inside the pull request.
Parse an architecture decision record and the requirements it covers.
Compute the hash of the evaluated outcome so it can be verified later.
Show the list of evaluated cases on a web page.
Create the web application with its routes.
Turn Jira wiki markup into readable text.
Match a commit author to a Jira account to see who wrote the code.
Send a weekly email digest of open requirements to project managers.
Export the traceability report as a PDF file.
Let users reset their password through an emailed link.
Charge a late fee when a library book is returned after the due date.
Resize uploaded profile pictures to thumbnails.
